abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the clinical characteristics and treatment of large ovarian masses in adolescents. METHODS: Adolescents with large ovarian masses (≥10 cm in diameter) who were treated in Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital from March 2010 to December 2018 were retrospectively assessed. RESULTS: Fifty-two female patients (mean age: 16.17±2.04 years [11-19 years]) were included and 19 (36.5%) presented with abdominal pain. The blood flow signal rate in ultrasonography was significantly different among benign, borderline and malignant ovarian masses, unlike strong echo, dotted echo and septation rates. Carbohydrate antigen 125 positivity rates were significantly different among pathological types and the endometriotic cyst group showed the highest value (75.0%). Alpha-fetoprotein positivity rates were also different among pathological types. For ovarian cystectomy, 14 and 32 patients underwent laparotomy and laparoscopy, respectively. Mass diameters were significantly higher in the laparotomy group and the operative duration was significantly shorter in the laparoscopy group. There were no significant differences in intraoperative blood loss or postoperative recurrence rates between the two groups. CONCLUSION: Teratomas constitute the greatest group of large ovarian masses in adolescents. Benign tumors should be treated by laparoscopic resection, while borderline or malignant tumors require individualized treatment of tumors and fertility-sparing treatments.
abstract_ja: 目的：思春期における大きな卵巣腫瘤の臨床的特徴と治療を検討すること。方法：2010年3月から2018年12月まで北京産婦人科病院で治療を受けた、直径10cm以上の大きな卵巣腫瘤を有する思春期患者を後方視的に評価した。結果：52名の女性患者(平均年齢16.17±2.04歳[11-19歳])が対象となり、19名(36.5%)が腹痛を呈した。超音波検査における血流信号の割合は、良性、境界悪性、悪性の卵巣腫瘤間で有意に異なったが、強エコー、点状エコー、隔壁の割合では差は認められなかった。Carbohydrate antigen 125陽性率は病理組織型間で有意に異なり、子宮内膜症性嚢胞群で最も高かった(75.0%)。αフェトプロテイン陽性率も病理組織型間で異なっていた。卵巣嚢胞摘出術として、14名が開腹術、32名が腹腔鏡下手術を受けた。腫瘤径は開腹群で有意に大きく、手術時間は腹腔鏡群で有意に短かった。術中出血量および術後再発率は両群間で有意差はなかった。結論：奇形腫は思春期の大きな卵巣腫瘤の中で最も多いグループである。良性腫瘍は腹腔鏡下切除で治療すべきであり、境界悪性または悪性腫瘍は腫瘍に対する個別化治療と妊孕性温存治療を必要とする。
